crossRefs.note: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there…
crossRefs.keyword: Heb. Flocks and oxen, all of them

translations.web: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,
translations.bsb: all sheep and oxen, and even the beasts of the field,
translations.kjv: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
translations.asv: All sheep and oxen, Yea, and the beasts of the field,
